terms.notes: Standard term in Latin American tech. Avoid 'plataforma colaborativa' which is less common.
Use 'en tiempo real' with preposition. Never 'tiempo-real' or 'a tiempo real'.
Preferred over 'equipos remotos' (remote teams) to emphasize distribution, not just remoteness.
Literal translation 'grado empresarial' sounds awkward. Use 'nivel empresarial' or 'para empresas'.
Multiple options: 'sin problemas', 'perfectamente', 'fluidamente'. Choose based on context formality.
Direct translation works well. Alternative: 'sobrecarga de notificaciones' (notification overload).
Use 'encriptación' (Latin America) not 'cifrado' (Spain). Maintain 'nivel bancario' for trust.
GDPR = RGPD (Reglamento General de Protección de Datos). Use full name on first mention.
Keep SOC 2 as acronym (widely recognized). No need to translate Service Organization Control.
Standard legal/business term. Don't use 'terceras partes' which is overly literal.
Direct cognate works perfectly. Avoid 'conexiones' or 'enlaces'.
Standard translation. Some markets use 'área de trabajo' but 'espacio' is more common.
Preferred over anglicism 'onboarding'. Alternative: 'integración inicial' for clarity.
Idiomatic expression needs cultural adaptation. 'Revolucionaria' captures impact better than literal 'cambia el juego'.
Idiomatic expression. 'Tranquilidad' is natural, avoid literal 'paz mental'.
Direct cognate works. Alternative: 'requisito fundamental' (fundamental requirement).
Standard e-commerce term. Avoid 'trial gratis' (anglicism + redundancy).

terms.notes: Use impersonal 'se requiere' form. Common in Spanish marketing copy.
Capitalize as proper noun (product tier name). 'Empresarial' preferred over 'de Negocios'.
Keep 'Enterprise' in English (industry standard for top tier). Alternative: 'Plan Corporativo'.
Formal command form. Alternative informal: 'Contacta Ventas' (for younger audiences).
Keep SLA acronym. 'Disponibilidad' preferred over 'tiempo activo' for professional context.
Use 'local' (local/on-site) not 'en las instalaciones' (too wordy). Alternative: 'on-premise' kept as tech term.
Standard business term. Some regions use 'ejecutivo de cuenta' (account executive).
Translate 'endpoints' as 'puntos finales'. Keep API untranslated (universal acronym).
Direct translation works. Alternative: 'ayuda con la migración' (slightly less formal).
HIPAA term. Keep as translated full name with (BAA) acronym in parentheses.
Avoid anglicism 'branding'. Use 'personalización de marca' or 'marca personalizada'.
'Panel' preferred over 'tablero'. Keep lowercase unless at sentence start.
Adjective follows noun in Spanish. Alternative: 'soporte con prioridad'.

style_guide.number_format: Use period for thousands (1.000), comma for decimals (1,5) per Latin American convention
style_guide.capitalization: Follow Spanish rules - capitalize less than English
style_guide.brand_names: Keep original: CloudSync Pro, CloudTech Inc.
style_guide.technical_terms: Translate when natural Spanish term exists, keep English when widely adopted (API, Cloud, SaaS)

regional_considerations.vocabulary: Use Latin American Spanish (encriptación not cifrado, computadora not ordenador)
regional_considerations.currency_symbol: $ (dollar sign) is standard in LatAm, not necessar to specify USD unless ambiguous
